papers.overlap: Predicting fine-detection gain from coarse outputs, sequential selection, prior-view history and compute-aware rewards are established.
papers.possible_difference_not_validated: Candidate30 proposed using realized coarse/fine detection disagreements, rather than only coarse accuracy-gain maps and region history. Its fixed diagonal schedule failed the headroom gate before training, so no contribution is established.
